body:

Disappointed, I thought of the past and the enhanced orgasms I had gotten long ago with pot, so I got some. Greatly enhanced feelings were there as in the past, but still no orgasms until I got some JWH-018. Then WOW !!!!!!
Scared by the reports of bad experiences with JWH-018, I just got a toothpick (flat kind) and picked up a barely visible amount (about 1/8 of an inch long, maybe 1/16 of an inch wide & 1/32 of an inch high) and inhaled it (vaporized) thru a Ubie brand glass tube vaporizer.
Not only did I have an orgasm during copulation, but kept having powerful ones over and over until I was exhausted. The weird thing was I didn't ejaculate, but as I said, Who cares? At my age I don't want babies, I just want orgasms.
But that wasn't all. I found that just about any erogenous area my wife rubbed, licked or kissed (ears, nipples, underarms, scrotum, etc.) could often bring about an orgasm. All I could say was WOW!
My wife was happy too. I have an ED problem and use injected Trimix

which keeps me erect for about an hour, won't go away for an hour either even if I want it to. Good thing I run a few miles a day. Otherwise I could probably be in danger of a heart attack (but what a way to go).
I told my urologist about my experience. He'd never heard of such a thing, but the urologist couldn't study it since it has now gone Sched. 1 and would be illegal to possess. He also said he wouldn't put this in my record since the US govt. wants all medical records on-line and available to it.
I told myself I'd write this up so others who may have the same problem may find the solution (albeit now illegal) on-line and may even entice a reputable research organization to study this.
